results.name: No Leader
results.description: The trading post operates with no leadership, which could lead to unresolved disputes.

results.name: Hereditary
results.description: A non-elected leader is in power, by virtue of their bloodline.

results.name: Merchant Monarch
results.description: The wealthiest shop owner in the trading post leads by default.

results.name: Underworld or Criminal Enterprise
results.description: A criminal, or group of criminals, either publicly, or privately, controls the trading post.

results.name: Oligarchy
results.description: A few individuals hold sway, collectively, over the trading post (which group is rolled next).

results.name: Local Council
results.description: Prominent members of the community were chosen to lead the trading post collectively.

results.name: Single, Elected Leader
results.description: The locals democratically voted for their current leader.

results.name: Anarcho-Syndicalist Commune
results.description: The members of the trading post take turns as a sort of executive officer for the week.
